value.body: Dairy cooperatives and milk unions, poultry integrators, and animal-feed and animal-health companies employ veterinarians for herd and flock health, breeding and artificial insemination programmes, disease control, nutrition advice and technical sales. Much of the work is in the field, with farmers.

items.label: Milk production
items.note: India is the world's largest milk producer

items.label: Registration
items.note: Needed to practise as a veterinarian

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A BVSc & AH with completed internship and registration with the Veterinary Council of India or a State Veterinary Council. Cooperatives and companies hire through their own advertisements, campus visits and referrals; there is no common entrance exam.

value.title: At a glance
items: Field roles involve regular travel to villages and farms.
Technical-sales roles combine animal-health advice with product sales targets.
An MVSc in animal nutrition, animal genetics and breeding, or poultry science suits specialist roles.
Work follows livestock regions — for example, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu and Telangana lead egg output (BAHS 2024).
